new_ops.name: transformerxl_relative_attention
new_ops.reason: The model uses the Transformer-XL (Dai et al. 2019) relative positional encoding scheme. This needs a causal softmax attention primitive whose logits add content-position terms computed from relative-distance embeddings. In Transformer-XL these are sinusoidal relative embeddings projected per layer, plus learned global biases. The output has shape [T, heads*head_dim]. The relative distance can be clamped at 2048 when evaluating on longer contexts. The paper gives none of these internal details itself; it only references the scheme, so the exact formulation has to come from the cited work.
new_ops.quote: we use the relative positional encoding scheme from \citet{dai2019transformer} rather than absolute positional encodings.

output.notes: Described the Gopher family. Primary config is the singled-out Gopher 280B; the five smaller family models are listed as configs. The paper says it uses the GPT-2 architecture with RMSNorm and Transformer-XL relative positions. Values not restated are therefore marked inherited from GPT-2: pre-norm, GELU (tanh form, as in the GPT-2 implementation), biases, tied embeddings, final norm and no MoE. d_ff is derived from the caption '4 x d_model', so each per-config number does not appear verbatim in the source. n_kv_heads, norm eps and attention scale are not stated. Relative attention is represented as an unsupported new op.
